Here you will find more than 5,000 books, each signed by famous authors who stayed at the Ambassade Hotel upon invitation of their publishers. At ‘Samsara Books & Art’, the hotel’s art- and bookstore around the corner, you will find books, gifts, and unique souvenirs. Ask for the unique ‘Art & Culture’ tours and packages, including a tour around the Art & Literature inside the hotel. Looking for a place to unwind?
